compluetic reaction.translation: [医] 梅毒补体结合反应, 乏色曼氏反应(检梅毒)

compluvium.definition:
n. A space left unroofed over the court of a Roman
   dwelling, through which the rain fell into the impluvium or cistern.

comply.definition: v. act in accordance with someone's rules, commands, or wishes
comply.translation:
vi. 顺从, 依从
[法] 遵守, 承诺, 照做

complying.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Comply
complying.translation: v. 遵从, 依从, 服从( comply的现在分词 )
